stem: Which clinical sign, often found in skin flexures or the base of the neck, may indicate insulin resistance?
explanation: This thickened, pigmented skin is highlighted as a clinical indicator of insulin resistance, especially in patients with darker skin tones.
rationale: Look for a term describing thickened, pigmented skin changes.

optionExplanations.A: This thickened, pigmented skin is highlighted as a clinical indicator of insulin resistance, especially in patients with darker skin tones.
optionExplanations.B: While common in weight gain, stretch marks (striae) are not specifically cited in the text as indicators of insulin resistance.
optionExplanations.C: This is mentioned as a red flag associated with headaches or visual disturbances, not a skin condition.
optionExplanations.D: This refers to involuntary urination and is mentioned as a potential complication, not a physical skin sign.
